Application

Konstanz on Lake Constance Acknowledgement of receipt within a week

Your documents

01

CV and cover letter as PDF, DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF or TXT — up to 5 MB each and 12 MB together. Please note: if anything is missing when you submit, you will have to choose the files again. That is not us being awkward; it is a rule of the browser.

We need one of the next three fields — which one is up to you.

We process your documents solely for this application procedure (§ 26 (1) BDSG) and delete them six months after it ends. What goes where is set out in the Privacy policy.

Procedure

02

Four steps, with no rounds in between: an acknowledgement of receipt within a week, a conversation of about an hour, a technical part built on a task from our own work — paid if it takes longer than two hours — and then the decision. Usually three weeks from arrival to offer.

We do not ask for a photo, a date of birth or marital status. We do not need them, and they play no part in the decision. If your CV carries them anyway, we look past them.

Prefer email? info@control-f.io takes the same documents.
